messages:
Sara (Support): user reports promo code copied from our tweet 'JOIN-REDWOOD🎉' shows 'Invalid or expired promo code' at checkout. customer email: carol@example.com. attached screenshot and dev tools copy.
Maya (Support): repro'd locally. paste into checkout input -> banner 'Invalid code'. Tried in API: POST /v1/promos/apply body { "code": "JOIN-REDWOOD🎉" } -> 400 {"error":"invalid_promo"}.
Maya (Support): curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REQ' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"JOIN-REDWOOD🎉","user_email":"carol@example.com"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error": "invalid_promo", "message": "Code invalid or expired" }
```
Maya (Support): raw paste bytes from Chrome clipboard inspector: JOIN-REDWOOD\uF0\u9F\u8E\u89 (emoji U+1F389 appended). Not a hidden whitespace — it's the confetti emoji.
Oliver (Eng): thanks for the repro. server validation currently enforces /^[A-Z0-9-]+$/ and rejects anything outside that (no unicode emoji). Marketing added emoji to the asset which customers copy/paste.
Oliver (Eng): quick mitigation options: 1) CS can issue manual credit (ok to do now) 2) short-term API change: normalize incoming codes by stripping common non-alphanum like emoji and zero-width chars (low-risk) 3) long-term: ensure marketing assets avoid non-code glyphs.
Raj (Billing): issuing manual trial credit now for carol@example.com (3-day trial) and flagging invoice if charged.
PromoBot: Ticket INF-3245 created by Oliver: "Normalize promo code input to ignore trailing/prefixed emoji and nonprinting glyphs" https://tickets.redwood.ai/INF-3245
Oliver (Eng): I'll put a 1-line normalization in the promo service today (strip anything outside ASCII alnum/hyphen) and add a small unit test. Deploy ETA 3 hours if no regressions.
Maya (Support): noted, told customer we issued a manual trial and engineering is pushing a fix; customer said thanks and will try again in 4 hours.
Sara (Support): marked thread resolved in support UI after customer confirmed code applied without emoji and credit is visible. Closing once INF-3245 is merged. :white_check_mark:
Raj (Billing): noted, I'll follow up if any billing artifacts show up.
